suggestions.title: There Will Be Blood
suggestions.description: A ruthless oil prospector strikes it rich in early 20th-century California, sacrificing everything in his pursuit of wealth. Paul Thomas Anderson's sprawling epic of family, faith, power, and oil is anchored by one of the greatest performances in cinema history — Daniel Day-Lewis's mesmerizing, terrifying Daniel Plainview. A slow-burning masterpiece of ambition and greed.

suggestions.title: Singin' in the Rain
suggestions.description: A silent-film star struggles to adapt to the new world of talking pictures in Hollywood's golden age. Gene Kelly and Stanley Donen's joyful, endlessly rewatchable musical is routinely hailed as the greatest song-and-dance film ever made — anchored by Kelly's iconic, rain-soaked title number and Donald O'Connor's show-stopping 'Make 'Em Laugh.' Pure, infectious movie magic from a classic era.

suggestions.title: Senna
suggestions.description: The remarkable life and tragic death of Brazilian Formula One racing legend Ayrton Senna. Asif Kapadia's groundbreaking film — built entirely from archival footage and audio, no talking heads — captures the intensity, genius, and spirituality of a three-time world champion whose death at Imola in 1994 shook the world. A gripping, emotional sports documentary unlike any other.
